when Origin is EXTERNAL, otherwise this value is omitted.

keyState.description:
Gets and sets the property KeyState.

Key State Affects the Use of a Customer Master Key in the AWS Key Management
Service Developer Guide.

Gets and sets the property KeyUsage.

only allowed value is ENCRYPT_DECRYPT, which means you can use the CMK for

key material.

expires, AWS KMS deletes the key material and the CMK becomes unusable. This

is KEY_MATERIAL_EXPIRES, otherwise this value is omitted.
